test_title: SSC CPO 2025 Official Paper (Held On 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Srinagar's seminar was held on Monday, Jammu hosted its seminar 3 days after Srinagar. Leh had its seminar 2 days before Jammu, and Kargil had its seminar on the same day of the week as Jammu. What day was Kargil's seminar?
solution:
Given:

Srinagar's seminar was held on Monday.

Jammu hosted its seminar 3 days after Srinagar → Monday + 3 days = Thursday.

Leh had its seminar 2 days before Jammu → Thursday − 2 days = Tuesday.

Kargil had its seminar on the same day of the week as Jammu → Thursday.
